text: If you make UGC, you know the grind. Cold emailing brands or sitting on fiber and upwork, hoping someone finds you. But MrBeast Creator platform Viro just opened its doors to UGC creators. Instead of pitching brands one by one, you can match with brands who actually fit what you make. So it's simple. Go to Viro.com, sign up and select UGC Creator when it asks. And once you're in, you can set your rate and add up to 5 of your best videos. And it's legit, creators are already getting paid on campaigns for MrBeast and other major brands. So if that sounds like you, go to viral.com and sign up.
